component.name: Suno Platform
component.summary: Shared libraries and the Suno application kit

description.p: The Suno Platform is the Flatpak runtime for Suno applications. It is built from the same Fedora 44 packages as the Suno operating system, including Suno's GTK 4, libadwaita, the Suno Developer Platform, the Prairie icon theme and Suno's fonts, so an application looks and behaves the same on Suno and on any other distribution with Flatpak.
